As years passed by, she grew closer to her aunts while her mom lived away from them because of work. With three people looking after her, Gelai still believed their love was not enough. In high school, she learned to cut classes, go home late, and neglect her studies.

videos.title: Journal
videos.overview: Follow the story of couple Alanis and Hennesy, who will fight for their love in spite of their health conditions: Alanis has a chronic kidney disease while Paolo has gastroesophageal reflux disease. Despite his own condition, Hennesy will refuse to have himself checked just to be by Alanis' side at all times, giving her priority over his studies.

videos.title: Family Portrait
videos.overview: While ordinary Filipinos were aware of the legislative career of Sen. Edgardo Angara, whose laws he wrote or co-wrote changed their lives, his life as a family man was a contrast, as he spent most of his time away from his family due to his busy schedule as a senator. Will he ever forgive his wife and children and give them hope?

videos.title: Steak
videos.overview: The life story of Christopher Lawrence "Bong" Go, from his tumultuous childhood to his time as a family man and assistant to Rodrigo Duterte, who would become the most controversial president of the country.

videos.title: Eyes
videos.overview: After suffering from a miscarriage during their first attempt, Marizo and Wilfred vow to do better with Kobe . As her family grows, Marizo vows to protect her sons from getting hurt. However, she soon learns that Kobe wants to learn how to ride the motorcycle. Despite trying to prevent her son from getting hurt, Marizo’s life suddenly turns upside down when Kobe gets involved in an accident.

videos.title: Basketball Court
videos.overview: After engaging in a romantic relationship at a young age, Tin and Tantan get their hearts broken as their immaturity got the best of them. However, when they encounter much serious problems as they get older, Tin and Tantan find themselves running to each other for comfort and strength. Not wanting to be away from his partner, Tantan makes a tough decision when Tin opts to sacrifice for her family by working abroad.

videos.title: Medal
videos.overview: Inspired by her father, Nesthy chases her dream of becoming a great boxer despite being told by her rude relatives that boxing is just for boys. Just as she is flourishing in the Philippine Women's Boxing National Team, she finds herself struggling when problems befall her family, causing her mental toughness to deteriorate. Soon, the athlete suffers a crippling setback, but she takes it as an opportunity to grow more in the sport. Rising above the pain and failures, Nesthy continues to strive hard to fulfill her dreams for herself and her family and to prove that women can succeed in a field dominated by men.

videos.title: Cars
videos.overview: Bound by common interests, Danny and Lorna find it easy to build a friendship despite their 34-year age gap. As their special bond develops into something deeper, the two struggle to contain their feelings and eventually give in to their hearts' desires. In spite of all their differences and their family's harsh judgement, Danny and Lorna vow to beat all odds and grow old together.

videos.title: Bamboo
videos.overview: Born in poverty, Darius grows up witnessing the struggles of his parents in making ends meet. Despite having a disability, the one-legged boy resolves to find a job to help his family. After a tragic event, his siblings unravel each other’s suppressed frustrations that lead their household to fall apart even more than they already are. Darius refuses to fall into misery and takes a chance to get on with life with his improvised bamboo leg.

videos.title: Shackled
videos.overview: The successful love story of Karen’s parents has always been her inspiration in searching for a perfect relationship. However, Karen gives up on her search for Mr. Right upon experiencing a series of heartbreaks, ultimately deciding to embrace her lonely fate. Just as when she has become adamant to guard her heart, she meets police bachelor Jayson who manages to make her believe in love anew. Soon, Karen fails to avoid another heartache, pushing her to realize that love is anything but perfect.

videos.title: Rails
videos.overview: Aira experiences a fairytale-like love story when she meets her prince charming, Jason. However, their awfully sweet relationship ends in a painful breakup when Aira’s love for Jason gets out of hand. While Aira tries to move forward, Jason succumbs to loneliness and hits rock bottom. Slowly realizing her mistakes, Aira resolves to win back Jason who has unfortunately resolved to forget her.

videos.title: Mural
videos.overview: Knowing that his dream of becoming a professional basketball player is unattainable, Jerry pours his heart and soul into making art. Through this, he meets Sheryl whom he builds a family with despite her parents’ disapproval. After losing his family because of a mistake, a chain of ill-fated events causes his life to fall apart. Through art, a hopeful Jerry tries to get back on track with his idol Kobe Bryant's Mamba mentality as his inspiration

videos.title: River
videos.overview: 30 years ago, Ferdinand Plazo whom he met Elvira will full affection of two hearts that only shattering her life onto her stricted parents namely for her uncle (Quizon) and mainly for her mother (Delgado), she offended by whom rejected by affair. But in which boundaries and out distance for success, ten years later the first child born followed by another one born both men diagnosed with severe mental disorders in which the pregnant woman have a dynasty from the first birth. Then followed by a third child in which he is too shy but felted anxious to tease everyone for his characteristics, Elvira encouraged to Ferdi that he had feel happy and proud for the forth and last child born normal both females. but in occurrence that due to heavy risk that Elvira's Mother cursed that they will suffer at heavy risk, by that the couples simplified their skills and abilities to whom in future.

videos.title: Bracelet
videos.overview: El and Lerma forge a loving relationship while pursuing their dreams as doctors. However, a challenging situation soon forces them to face the harsh reality of their responsibilities in the medical field.

videos.title: Notebook
videos.overview: Arnel was an ambiguous man, he pursuing his dreams on writing all of his ambiguous memory for his future as a Seaman, however distractions ahead in scribbled his illness for fortune. Will he achieve his goals to pursue an attracted light?

videos.title: Pancit
videos.overview: Kristine tries to fulfill her promise to her departed mother that she will be reunited with her siblings every Christmas against all odds.

videos.title: Wedding Ring
videos.overview: After finally taking her family to Dubai through sheer determination and hard work, Vagelyn finds herself looking for someone to fill the gap inside her heart. Following several attempts in dating, she reconnects with high school batchmate and notorious bully, Janwell. Brushing aside their interactions online as mere coincidence, Vagelyn soon realizes the possibility of turning their budding relationship into a life-long commitment.

videos.title: TV
videos.overview: Despite his numerous rejections and failures, Carlo's perseverance and determination eventually lead him to make a name for himself in the showbiz industry as JC Alcantara.

videos.title: Tattoo
videos.overview: After her heart got broken for the second time because of her boyfriend Gio's incessant infidelity, Karla finds a new reason to be happy upon reconnecting with her former classmate, Ralph. Convinced that he is the right one for her, Karla fights for their love amid her family's and friends' concern about her boyfriend's baggage. Ralph's insecurities, however, begin to put a rift on their relationship, leaving Karla back to square one. A realization soon dawns upon her while she tries to pick herself back up.

videos.title: Bible
videos.overview: Bert instantly forms a friendship with Dodong and takes him under his wing as soon as he finds out his family situation. Despite hating his father Ismael for leaving their family, a strong urge to avenge him engulfs Bert after the former was brutally murdered. Bent on giving justice to his father, his brother Rey's preaching about forgiveness falls on deaf ears until Bert finds himself on death's doorstep. However, the pain of his past haunts him when he finally reunites with Dodong while threading on the spiritual path.

videos.title: Blouse
videos.overview: Janice is happily living her dream with her boyfriend Eddie until his mother Corsing enters the picture and frowns on their relationship. Upon building a new life with Eddie, Janice moves heaven and earth just to please Corsing, who remains hostile towards her daughter-in-law as her way to spare Eddie from possible heartbreak. Although a series of unfortunate incidents befalls her family, Janice’s efforts soon begin to finally pay off.

videos.title: Land Title
videos.overview: Rebecca was a hard-working woman in just unusual command by her family in a rural province, since her life became low since she had been argued by her siblings bout their share on allowances and personal problems, will she ever complied to achieve her better goals to live in his foreign spice?

videos.title: Cane
videos.overview: Petrus is a blind person who had ability to make choices to help by staying as close to his brother Raddy although some disadvantages occurred once she made unhonorable needs when he married and no one wondered for when he will cast his dignity.

videos.title: Stage
videos.overview: Ivy loves to act on stage but she agreed to put it on hold when her boyfriend Ian asked her to when he proposed marriage so that they can have children. But Ivy was unable to return to acting even after having four children as Ian continued to forbid her. Sacrificing her passion, Ivy set up a school with her husband. Even as she followed a new path in life, the two continued to fight, which eventually resulted in their separation. Ivy was able to pursue acting again with the help of her children and the teachers in her school. This is when she met Carl, a young theater actor whom Ivy had to mentor. Despite their 16 year age gap, Ivy fell in love and took a risk by having a relationship with him.

videos.title: Quarantine Pass
videos.overview: Zaldy and Jex work as chefs in an airline catering services company. Jex has a longtime crush on Zaldy and not wasted time asking him out. But to her disappointment, Zaldy keeps rejecting her invitation. As Jex leaves the company to look for greener pastures, the two eventually lose touch with each other only to reconnect years later after failed relationships. It doesn't take long before they eventually start dating. As the pandemic was brewing, the two decide to push through with their planned trip to Baguio. With their more-than-friends, less-than-lovers status, the two find themselves stuck together indefinitely in the city as Luzon is put into lockdown.

videos.title: Jacket
videos.overview: Larcy's world gets crushed when she learns about her husband Jun's affair with Rose, with whom he has a child named Ryan. But instead of leaving him, Larcy decides to make a sacrifice to make her family complete again. When she learns that the woman has decided to leave Jun, Larcy offers to take care of their son. But her effort does not pay off as their relationship continues to fall apart. Nevertheless, she has no regrets about loving Ryan. Things eventually get complicated when Rose comes back after many years to take Ryan back.

videos.title: Microphone
videos.overview: Jann Mar forgets about his fear of rejection to find his estranged biological father, only to be dejected in the end. Armed with his stepfather’s advice, JM finally follows his heart as he tries his luck in “Tawag ng Tanghalan.”

videos.title: Gold
videos.overview: The story tells about the first Philippine Olympic Gold Medalist Hidilyn Diaz's sake to pursuing her goals to her dreams as a weightlifter in the history of Philippine sports, she was among the 5 siblings of a family living in Zamboanga in which are strike on poverty, and her passion was to join the said sport in order to make herself put of difficult living, since she was participating in international meets and earned better income, she tries her best to get the Olympic medal but until in 2016 in Rio Games she got her bag full of silver.

videos.title: Book
videos.overview: Valerie dreams of a better life with her siblings, Ali and Cha, until her brother follows the footsteps of their father Lando. As the cracks of their relationship widen, their love for their family drives them to find their way back together.

videos.title: Scarf
videos.overview: Tanch's efforts pay off when a devout Sarah decides to follow her heart. Things get complicated as Juan, the father of Tanch's son, demands something that drives a wedge between the two. As Sarah tries to move on, a realization dawns on her.

videos.title: Tattoo
videos.overview: Edwin follows in his family's footsteps of earning a living through illicit ways. Amid his degree, he sticks with his old habits in the US until he returns to the Philippines. As he makes things right, he finds the meaning of his life in tattooing.

videos.title: Silver Medal
videos.overview: The untold story of 2020 Summer Olympics silver medalist Carlo Paalam has a life being with sports for boxing than his strive of career, however prejudice has fall into his flame for his favor but how long will take a while if he goes to lost for someone for passion?

videos.title: Slot Machine
videos.overview: The addictice princess just for longing for happy ending, this is how Baby shows to share her thoughts about her passionate living with her true story about her hidden relationship with David and also she had an outstanding unpaid debts to her neighbour but her way was to play in the Casino topay at her imposter, while her older children was in overseas she was in a nervous breakdown on how to deal to disclose, will Baby make apologies for her bad actions to her family?

videos.title: Church
videos.overview: After constant searching for "the right one" on Facebook, John got to meet Angel who would eventually become his girlfriend. Their growing romance will be tested when Angel was diagnosed with breast cancer. How will the young couple managed to keep themselves together, fight for their love, and build a life of their own?

videos.title: Caramel Sundae
videos.overview: Tess is born to a poverty-stricken family and usually supports her mother, who is suffering from postpartum depression. While studying, she works as a crew member in a fast-food chain where he meets John, who unlike her is born wealthy but opposite attract by their means of love, along with their deep experience about life and crossfading, their intention to strike out anything else but nobody, however it some difficult talents, Tess had applied to an appliance store as a finance officer while John upholds as an engineer, soon as long they not been going to pursue sweet surrender or what they can any distance for love as shattering apart?

videos.title: Jail Cell
videos.overview: Karen Bordador has just started to gain a reputation for herself as a highly-regarded and popular radio DJ, and as an up-and-coming fashion model and television personality. However, success starts to swerve at the wrong direction as Karen would be arrested for illegal drugs after visiting her then boyfriend. This not only jeopardized her well-established career, but so as her mother Norie as she has to bear all the negative news and comments about Karen in private. How will she maintain a positive outlook if she will have to endure her time in prison longer than what she expects? How will she adjust to her new found life behind bars?

videos.title: Tablet
videos.overview: The story of Karen Bordador continues as she got to adjust to life in prison while keeping a positive outlook. With many legal hurdles and the coronavirus pandemic situation both affecting the judicial process and life in jail itself, Karen starts to lose hope as delays to her case keep on occurring. With the final promulgation being done on a tablet from jail, will she ever get a second take on her chance to rebuild her life and fulfill her dreams outside?

videos.title: Altar
videos.overview: Michael, Angelo, and Anthony Villadarez are three brothers who become orphans as they lose both of their parents during their childhood. Their grandmother Deling decides to be her grandchildren’s guardian despite her estranged relationship with them before due to their parents’ lack of wealth. Over the years, the brothers grow even closer to their grandmother to the point where they make it their end goal for all of them to be together with better lives abroad. However, as they each leave their grandmother behind one by one to study and work towards their dreams in Canada, their patience continues to be tested through the prolonged wait for immigration to approve Deling’s documents. Can the Villadarez brothers all return to the Philippines to take care of their grandmother when she falls ill, or do they remain overseas in hopes that they will bring her to their new home?

videos.title: Ring
videos.overview: Mae meets Pio when she goes on a hike to heal from her recent heartbreak. As the two eventually fall in love with each other, Pio suffers from a life-altering disease that would put their blossoming relationship to the test.

videos.title: Ring Light
videos.overview: Daisy continues to work hard, this time abroad, working as a performer until she returned back home. Even back home, she communicates with her foreigner boyfriend, would eventually meet up in person and introduce him to her family, and would bear a daughter with him. Suddenly, Daisy's mother was stricken by a stroke for the third time. This forced Daisy to give up her savings just to take care of her now bed-ridden mother. Her relationship with her boyfriend would be strained due to lockdowns, and led to them separating after learning she was being cheated. Despite these, she continued to use her "Madam Inutz" persona in her live selling sessions online, and continued to tend to her mother's care. This led to her receiving support from her "miners," the overflow of online projects, and eventually land as a celebrity housemate while keeping her promise for her family.

videos.title: Logbook
videos.overview: Living up to his father's principles, Mel decides to take matters into his own hands when his employers mistreat him and his men. His relentless efforts soon payoff, until he finds himself embroiled in another legal battle.

videos.title: Jail Cell
videos.overview: Mel tries to clear his name head-on until unforeseen circumstances force him to run away from the law. When he still ends up behind bars, the wrongfully accused patriarch slowly begins to turn his back on his moral principles.

videos.title: Bracelet
videos.overview: Growing up under the care of her aunt, Joy cannot help but admire Marlita and hope to repay her sacrifices someday. When her half-sister Sofia ends up with her, Joy gladly assumes responsibility, thinking that Marlita did the same for her.

videos.title: Cake
videos.overview: Wena meets Greg online at the darkest time of her life but the scars of her past force the aspiring nurse to cut him off amid her growing feelings. Despite saying their goodbyes, the two find themselves slowly overcoming their greatest fears.

videos.title: Bicycle
videos.overview: James takes it upon himself to provide for his family to the point of swallowing his pride as he becomes an escort. Amid his attempt to start over with a clean slate with his boyfriend, James' dark past continues to haunt him.

videos.title: Passport
videos.overview: Olie's dream of having a complete family falls through when her Muslim husband dies suddenly. Rejecting her brother-in-law's marriage proposal, Olie pulls out all the stops to reunite with the son she left behind.

videos.title: Engagement Ring
videos.overview: Despite Viktoria's life-threatening disease, Nick refuses to walk away and decides to fight for their love in sickness and in health. When his girlfriend's lupus worsens, Nick does something unexpected.

videos.title: Shanghai Rolls
videos.overview: Joan's life makes an unexpected turn following the deaths of her parents, leaving her with the responsibility of taking care of her sister Jai. However, her strength is put to the test when Jai gets diagnosed with schizophrenia.

videos.title: Medallion
videos.overview: For years, Billy has been trying to ignore his paranormal ability for fear of being ostracized. Just as he meets someone who truly accepts him, Billy faces the greatest fight of his life.

videos.title: Family Picture
videos.overview: Determined to give her family a better life, Abby is forced to endure her tragic fate abroad. Though she finds a way to cope with her situation, Abby refuses to make no move when another group of unsuspecting victims arrives.

videos.title: Bottle
videos.overview: Abby finds a family in Iris and company no matter how she tries to stop herself from growing closer to them. While Abby receives a shocking revelation about her husband, an opportunity to return home presents itself to the abused women.

videos.title: Passport
videos.overview: Abby finally returns home to her family in the Philippines, only to be a prisoner of her hellish experience abroad. Heeding Iris' advice, Abby faces her inner demons as she slowly makes a fresh start with her newfound love.

videos.title: Fire
videos.overview: Sofronio's dream of becoming a singer takes a back seat when he reluctantly follows his father's wish. His passion and confidence suffer a major hit after countless losses, but it seems fate has other plans for him as another opportunity comes in.

videos.title: Camera
videos.overview: Sheena shares a strong bond with her mother Angelyn and together, they envision a future where she will become a performer. However, a tragedy strikes just when their goal is within reach, leaving Sheena full of doubts about their once-shared dream.

videos.title: House
videos.overview: Cruz and Lovella Maguad reluctantly give in to their children's request and adopt Janice, treating her like their own. As time passes, the couple grows increasingly suspicious of her until a tragedy befalls their family.

videos.title: Envelope
videos.overview: The Maguad couple's world comes crashing down after the brutal killings of their children. To make matters worse, Jasmine is revealed to have a hand in the crime. Amid their pursuit of justice, Cruz and Lovella are forced to face the harrowing truth.

videos.title: Gumamela
videos.overview: After a miscarriage, Marissa loses another shot at motherhood when her husband sends her stepdaughter, Angel, away to live with his parents. Years later, Angel returns distant and rebellious, falling into a nightmare no mother could bear to imagine.

videos.title: SIM Card
videos.overview: Nadia is left with no choice but to start over and take a high-paying job offer in Thailand after losing her hard-earned money to a crypto scam, only to be deceived and trafficked into a cyber scam operation in Myanmar.

videos.title: Window
videos.overview: Nadia's refusal to continue working as a scammer turns her life into a living hell. Amid suffering unimaginable horror day after day, she desperately clings to a tinge of hope of seeing the children that she left behind.

videos.title: Makeup
videos.overview: Growing up in poverty, life is all about survival for Hajie until Lenie comes along. Despite rumors about Hajie's gender identity, the two become a couple and work together as a glam team, only for their personal struggles to test their relationship.

videos.title: Balloon
videos.overview: As if her sufferings at the hands of her mother and stepfather are not enough, Marlyn's life spirals further into misery when she becomes a victim of sex trafficking. But despite having a fresh start, her old wounds come back to haunt her.

videos.title: Medal
videos.overview: Trixia joins her school's sprint team, hoping to clinch a medal someday. Her career takes off to a great start even without properly fitting running shoes. And just within nine months, she joins a national event where she meets her biggest obstacle.

videos.title: Trumpo
videos.overview: Ricky once found comfort in a spinning top. Now a parent himself, he vows to never be like his own father. But as pressure builds, he begins to doubt himself until one day, he picks up his spinning top again—not to play, but to survive.

videos.title: Door
videos.overview: Everything changes for the worse for Eugene when his mother abandons them and when he comes out as gay. Shunned by his family, he is forced to fend for himself on the streets and face unimaginable odds to become a top student at a leading university.

videos.title: Habal-Habal
videos.overview: Andot's desire for independence and control over his own life pushes him to tread a dangerous path. But just when he gets the freedom he yearns for, a tragedy ultimately changes his life.
